saved_metadata.structural_audit: ZIP central directory read: 65 networks/subjectXX.npy plus 65 bursts/subjectXX.npy and demographics.csv; actual demographic CSV inspected (1,317 bytes). No signal members read.

data_contract.neural: Per-participant multichannel source time series in networks/subjectXX.npy; separate single-channel bursts series. Author recipe: 250 Hz, 38-parcel Giles atlas.

data_contract.split: Reproduction uses author cohort. Extension freezes participant splits before fitting PCA/state models; repeated seeds assessed without choosing on held-out age effects.
data_contract.controls: Stationary surrogate preserving spectra; matched static covariance baseline; participant-level permutation and resampling; separate state label matching from substantive neural interpretation.
